changelog.summary: Adds feed tiers and gates, replaces broad Google health/science feeds with vertical-authority health sources, adds EDGAR 8-K Atom, and shortens default feeds.

feeds.name: Techmeme
feeds.use_when: Default for technology, AI, SaaS, startup, platform, and developer-tool profiles.
feeds.notes: Curated tech/business front page. High precision for major tech stories.

feeds.name: Google News Technology
feeds.use_when: Use as a broad technology backstop when Techmeme may be too narrow.

feeds.name: Google News Business
feeds.use_when: Use for business, funding, M&A, markets, commercial real estate, and executive-change profiles only when a better vertical source does not fit.
feeds.notes: Broad business feed; requires stricter relevance filtering. Broad feed, expect noise.

feeds.name: Google News U.S.
feeds.use_when: Use when U.S. policy, courts, or national regulation are central to the client and a better vertical source does not fit.
feeds.notes: Broad and noisy. Avoid unless the client has policy standing. Broad feed, expect noise.

feeds.name: Google News World
feeds.use_when: Use for geopolitics, supply chain, global markets, and international policy profiles only when the client has direct standing.
feeds.notes: High tragedy/war exposure. Use only with direct public-interest standing. Broad feed, expect noise.

feeds.name: Memeorandum
feeds.use_when: Use for U.S. politics, public affairs, policy, and media-politics profiles when the client's beat overlaps the gate.
feeds.notes: Politically sensitive. Usually not appropriate for normal company newsjacking.

feeds.name: Mediagazer
feeds.use_when: Use for media, journalism, publishing, creator, and agency profiles when the client's beat overlaps the gate.
feeds.notes: Good companion to Techmeme for media-industry clients.

feeds.name: FTC Press Releases
feeds.use_when: Use for privacy, consumer protection, advertising claims, antitrust, and AI compliance profiles.
feeds.notes: Official source; slow but high authority.

feeds.name: SEC Press Releases
feeds.use_when: Use for fintech, crypto, public-company compliance, and investor-market profiles.
feeds.notes: Official source; useful for same-day expert commentary.

feeds.name: SEC EDGAR Current 8-K Filings
feeds.use_when: Use for fintech, crypto, public-company compliance, and any profile that benefits from being early on material-events disclosures.
feeds.notes: Real-time 8-K filings stream. High volume, requires keyword/ticker filtering by the skill. Pair with `sec-press` for press-release context.

feeds.name: GOV.UK News
feeds.use_when: Use for UK policy, regulated industries, property, and public-sector profiles.
feeds.notes: Broad official UK feed; requires topic filtering by the skill.

feeds.name: STAT News
feeds.use_when: Use for healthcare, biotech, pharma, life-sciences, public-health, and medical-research profiles.
feeds.notes: Vertical healthcare newsroom with stronger editorial authority than broad Google News health feeds.

feeds.name: FDA Press Releases
feeds.use_when: Use for pharma, biotech, medtech, patient-safety, drug-approval, food-safety, and FDA-regulated profiles.
feeds.notes: Official FDA press-release feed. High authority; pair with STAT or Endpoints for industry reaction.

feeds.name: CMS Newsroom Press Releases
feeds.use_when: Use for Medicare, Medicaid, health-policy, payer, provider, and health-insurance profiles.
feeds.notes: Official CMS newsroom RSS feed. Includes press releases and related newsroom items; filter by client beat and CMS context.

feeds.name: Endpoints News
feeds.use_when: Use for biotech, pharma, drug-development, life-sciences funding, and healthcare-business profiles.
feeds.notes: Biopharma industry feed with deal, trial, executive, and regulatory context. Requires relevance filtering for company-specific profiles.
